items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: dead now, Shirley Clay, he asked me if I wanted his permanent job.

ctx.x: Singleton, he was something! Well, then I played around and giged around there for awhile and then after I ran into this fellow -- dead now, Shirley Clay, he asked me if I wanted his permanent job. I told him yes. He said, 'Well, I'm going to New York,' he says, 'and you can have this job playing the theater,' -- the Cranshaw -- at the Hip -- no, at the Criterion Theater, just playing pictures, you know. Of course, you had toplay good music.
When silent movies came along, you know, came into town, did sheet music accompany them, you know, did you have certain music that you had to use?
